page_title: MNU 1-0 NEW | Manchester Utd v Newcastle 26/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Lisandro Martinez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tyler Fredricson (Manchester United).
88' Ruben Amorim has decided to make a change. Tyrell Malacia (Manchester United) replaces Luke Shaw.

85' Harvey Barnes plays a short pass through to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
84' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

80' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Senne Lammens anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
78' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Manchester Utd have a free kick.
78' The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
77' The substitution is prepared. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sandro Tonali.
75' A pass from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Senne Lammens and the move breaks down.

73' What an opportunity! Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which goes just over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
73' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is booked.
70' Referee Anthony Taylor sees the trip by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
69' Yellow card! It's like Luke Shaw (Manchester United) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Anthony Taylor agrees and books him.
69' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) for Jacob Murphy.
68' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Nick Woltemade and he is replaced by Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch for Jacob Ramsey.

68' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
65' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Newcastle! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Anthony Taylor and both teams have no complaints.
63' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
62' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
62' Now Newcastle have a corner.
62' That was close by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
61' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leny Yoro (Manchester United) replacing Casemiro.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) will replace Benjamin Sesko.
60' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) looks on in disbelief after missing his chance. He fires the rebound onto the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
58' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
55' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends a long ball in, but Senne Lammens comfortably gathers the ball.
53' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
51' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

49' A cross from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

48' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Newcastle.
46' Ruben Amorim makes a switch. Jack Fletcher is coming on in place of Mason Mount (Manchester United) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Dangerous play by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Newcastle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

36' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
34' Great save! Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Aaron Ramsdale.
33' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Manchester Utd get a corner.

31' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
28' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
24' 1 - 0 What a hit! Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

24' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Aaron Ramsdale makes a great save to stop the effort going into the left side of the goal.
23' The linesman raises his flag. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
22' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

22' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Newcastle will take a corner.
20' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Newcastle have a free kick.
19' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
19' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United). Newcastle win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
15' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
14' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

13' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
13' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) rises above the defence and powers a header at the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a superb save.
12' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
12' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.

11' Patrick Dorgu plays a pass to Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
10' Aaron Ramsdale (Newcastle Utd) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
8' Aaron Ramsdale (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

4' Mason Mount bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Casemiro (Manchester United) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
4' Mason Mount (Manchester United) prepares to take a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Newcastle will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is the one to supervise the game today.
